description: Creates a new label for a GitLab project with specified name, color, and optional attributes. Use this action when you need to create a new label for organizing issues and merge requests within a project. Labels help categorize and filter project items, making project management more efficient.

archived.description: If true, marks the label as archived. Default value: false.
archived.title: Archived

color.description: The color of the label given in 6-digit hex notation with leading '#' sign (e.g., #FFAABB) or CSS color names.
color.title: Color

examples: Critical bugs that need immediate attention
description.title: Description

id.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project (e.g., '12345', 'my-group/my-project', or 'my-group%2Fmy-project').
id.title: Id

priority.description: The priority of the label. Must be greater than or equal to zero or null to remove priority.
priority.title: Priority

name: create_label

archived.description: Indicates if the label is archived.
archived.title: Archived

closed_issues_count.description: The count of closed issues with this label.
closed_issues_count.title: Closed Issues Count

color.description: The color of the label in hex notation.
color.title: Color

description_html.description: The HTML description of the label.
description_html.title: Description Html

is_project_label.description: Indicates if this is a project-level label.
is_project_label.title: Is Project Label

open_issues_count.description: The count of open issues with this label.
open_issues_count.title: Open Issues Count

open_merge_requests_count.description: The count of open merge requests with this label.
open_merge_requests_count.title: Open Merge Requests Count

subscribed.description: Indicates if the user is subscribed to the label.
subscribed.title: Subscribed

text_color.description: The text color of the label in hex notation.
text_color.title: Text Color
